title: gmr1_bcch, gsm_rlcmac: Const-ify CSNDESCR structs.
description:
Most instances of the CSNDESCR structs were already "const"; Let's const-ify
the rest.  It seems they will never be written.  Moves another 14.4 kBytes from
a read-write data section to a read-only section.

(Some newlines added to honor the effort which had been put into aligning all
these records!)

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
